finding: 2,304 of 8,880 hours (25.9%) hold one constant vector across all 8 variables (upstream fill, close to the series mean). They arrive as observed: is_masked=FALSE, is_scorable=TRUE, fill_method=NA. Blocks sit on fixed calendar days; 600 of the last 744 hours are fill.
risk_for_B1_B2: Inputs carry a full-sample statistic. As targets they are synthetic and trivially predictable when origin and target fall in the same block. All six pollutants freeze together, so cross-pollutant features reveal the fill state.
mitigation: Overlay mask (proposed_quality_mask_cpcb.csv): fill and all-six stuck runs >= 6 h are never targets; apply policy.yaml origin and training-row rules to the mask; add a fill-indicator feature; keep the unmasked score only as a paper-comparable secondary number.

finding: Raw CSV last row (2023-07-06 00:00) clones row 1. The store drops it (8,880 rows). A 8,521/336/24 split adds up to 8,881, i.e. the raw row count.
risk_for_B1_B2: If T1 used the 8,881-row CSV, its 24-h test contains the cloned fill row and its 336-h validation window is 239/336 fill hours.
mitigation: Build B1/B2 from store/clean only. Confirm which row count T1 used before comparing against it.

finding: CPCB paper source skips imputation in the store (value_filled_causal = raw value). Legacy impute_hourly (imputeTS::na_seadec on the full series) is still called by prepare_series and paper_preprocess_15min (SHILLONG.csv). Phase 1a fills (M1-M8) are causal per step, but their parameters are fitted before selection_end = 2023-10-01.
risk_for_B1_B2: No repo-side look-ahead fill on CPCB. Legacy paths and non-CPCB stations could introduce it.
mitigation: Read inputs only from store/clean. Never call prepare_series or data/processed/series.rds for B1/B2. For other stations set selection_end before the test block.

finding: Store is unscaled and decompositions run on raw values (good). Legacy minmax_fit was fitted on train+val (AUDIT F12).
risk_for_B1_B2: Linear models, PCA, Sparse PCA, PLS, MI binning and pooled-target scaling all need fitted statistics that leak if fitted on more than the current fitting block.
mitigation: Fit every scaler and transform on the rows of the current fit only (train during selection, train+val for the final refit). Per-target scaling for pooled models, from training rows.

finding: Trailing-window store method mra_haar_J5: value at t uses x[t-2047..t] only. Sampled bump tests on all six CPCB pollutants: 0 change at t from bumps at t+1, t+24, t+168, t+336, t+744. Additivity error <= 7.1e-15.
risk_for_B1_B2: None for features or B2 targets, as long as the store (not the legacy helpers) is used.
mitigation: Use get_decomp()/stored parquet only. Run check_decomp_store.R on the local store before Phase 1.

location: R/04_modwt.R haar_mra/generic_mra; R/06_models.R paper_wave_walkforward, wave_fit_components, wave_walkforward_1step
finding: Legacy helpers apply a two-sided circular MRA to whatever vector is passed (AUDIT F1, F2). wave_walkforward_1step uses prefix endpoints at inference but interior values in training.
risk_for_B1_B2: Two-sided components at t depend on x[t+1..t+31] (Haar J5); full-series calls also see test values.
mitigation: Do not call these for B2. Phase 1 code should not source R/06_models.R wave helpers at all.

finding: The endpoint value of each component depends on x[t-31..t] and, through the circular wrap, on x[t-2047..t-2017]. A bump at t-2047 moves the endpoint as much as a bump at t-1. Endpoint vs settled value: median correlation 0.50 (D5) to 0.79 (D3); nRMSE 2.31 for D1.
risk_for_B1_B2: Components are causal but noisy real-time proxies of the frequency bands. B2 targets inherit the same noise, which is consistent but may limit B2 gains.
mitigation: Keep mra_haar_J5__raw as the protocol. Record coef_haar (causal pyramid, W1..W5+V5 additive, 31-h warm-up) as a possible later sensitivity check.

finding: selection_end falls back to 2023-10-01 and is clipped to the CPCB end (2023-07-05 23:00). The screen scores origins in the last 60 days and D3/D4 use data up to the series end.
risk_for_B1_B2: If the J5 Haar choice relied on screen results, method selection touched the proposed test block.
mitigation: Treat J5 Haar as fixed a priori for this study. Any re-screening must set selection_end <= 2023-04-03 23:00 (validation end).

finding: Frozen grid chosen on a CPCB PM2.5 split whose prefix contains most of the 7/14/31-day tests (AUDIT F5).
risk_for_B1_B2: Reusing these settings carries test information into B1/B2.
mitigation: Tune only on the new validation block. Do not read hparams.rds.

finding: Samples near block edges: training labels t+h can fall in validation or test unless purged.
risk_for_B1_B2: Label leakage across blocks, worst at h=744.
mitigation: Train: t+h <= train end. Validation/test: origin >= block start and t+h <= block end. Final refit: labels <= validation end; test origins >= test start.

finding: Other pollutants are only known up to the origin.
risk_for_B1_B2: Using x_q(t+1..t+h) of any pollutant q, or contemporaneous values at the target hour, is direct leakage. A recursive strategy would silently need these.
mitigation: All predictors at lags 0..23 from the origin. If a recursive strategy is chosen later, all pollutants (or all 36 components) must be forecast jointly.

finding: Default cv.glmnet folds are random; PCA/PLS/MI fitted on the full matrix would see validation and test rows.
risk_for_B1_B2: Shuffled CV leaks neighbouring hours; full-data transforms leak test structure.
mitigation: Select lambda, ncomp and k on the fixed validation block (or contiguous blocked folds with an h-hour purge inside train).

finding: Decomposition timestamps are written as UTC instants and converted back to IST on read. Joining on formatted local strings vs instants can shift rows by 5.5 h.
risk_for_B1_B2: Silent misalignment between pollutants or between features and targets.
mitigation: Join on instants and assert row-for-row equality with store/clean (check_decomp_store.R does this).

finding: frac_filled_24h is 0 for paper sources because fill rows are not flagged, so valid_strict equals valid_basic for CPCB.
risk_for_B1_B2: The strict flag gives no protection against the fill blocks.
mitigation: Use the Phase 0 mask, not valid_strict, for CPCB.

finding: MASE scale uses the whole y_train, including fill hours.
risk_for_B1_B2: Scale is shrunk by constant blocks (seasonal-naive error is 0 inside them).
mitigation: Compute the seasonal-naive (lag 24) scale on training-block pairs where both hours are scorable.

finding: CatBoost falls back to XGBoost when the package is missing.
risk_for_B1_B2: Results labelled CatBoost could be XGBoost.
mitigation: Stop with an error if catboost is missing; log package versions with every run.
